goals.title: Implement and verify Bankramen Android UX priorities 1-3: (1) user-gu...
goals.objective: Implement and verify Bankramen Android UX priorities 1-3: (1) user-guided NotificationListenerService activation and recoverable permission state, (2) visible automatic-recording status plus sync-failure feedback, (3) target-specific transaction deletion and mutation failure feedback. Preserve unrelated dirty work.

successCriteria.scenario: Authenticated first-time user completes the explanatory onboarding, deliberately opens Notification Listener settings, enables Bankramen, and returns to the app.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: No POST_NOTIFICATIONS prompt occurs at cold launch; onboarding and home each clearly explain automatic transaction recording; after app resume the home state changes from disabled to enabled based on the service-specific listener grant.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Cold launch on emulator-5554 opened LoginScreen without POST_NOTIFICATIONS dialog; ACTION_NOTIFICATION_LISTENER_SETTINGS displayed Bankramen under Not allowed; MainActivity no longer requests runtime permission; HomeScreen rechecks listener state on ON_RESUME. Authenticated onboarding interaction could not be driven without Kakao credentials.

successCriteria.scenario: Authenticated user has automatic-recording access disabled, has no parsed notification yet, or has a parsed notification whose upload failed.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Home presents a truthful recoverable disabled state with a settings action, a clear no-record-yet state, and a sanitized upload-failure state alongside the latest parsed transaction when available; no raw HTTP error is shown.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: HomeViewModel collects NotificationStore summary and persisted sanitized upload failure; AutomaticRecordingCard renders disabled/no-record/latest/failure states. Unit+assemble passed; direct authenticated UI fixture unavailable without credentials.

successCriteria.scenario: User removes a transaction or submits a mutation while the network rejects it, then uses system back from any confirmation or sheet.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: Only the explicitly chosen transaction can reach the delete confirmation; confirmation names that target; failure stays visible in the originating surface; back/dismiss cancels safely without deleting or losing the selected target.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Header-first-item delete path removed; row delete carries the selected transaction into AlertDialog copy; ViewModel reports missing IDs, guards duplicate deletion, and mutation error banner is visible. API26 listener fallback and ambiguous manual recurring ID rejection are covered by unit tests.

goals.title: Generate and integrate a non-verbal Bankramen Android launcher icon
goals.objective: Generate, inspect, and integrate a distinctive non-verbal launcher icon for the Bankramen Android app without overwriting unrelated existing assets; wire it through the adaptive icon foreground and verify the Android resource build.

successCriteria.scenario: A user installs the debug APK on Android 26 or newer and opens app information or Notification Listener settings.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: The package renders the generated non-verbal wallet-and-signal launcher icon through the adaptive foreground with no text or letterforms; the previous foreground source remains untouched.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Generated 1254x1254 non-verbal wallet/shield/signal PNG is referenced by launcher foreground. Emulator app-info and listener-settings screenshots show the icon next to Bankramen.

successCriteria.scenario: A device on API 24 or 25 resolves the launcher and round launcher resources without adaptive-icon support.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: New mipmap-anydpi bitmap fallbacks point to the same versioned foreground image, while pre-existing density-specific images are not overwritten.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: Added mipmap-anydpi bitmap launcher and round-launcher fallbacks to v1 asset for API24–25 without modifying the pre-existing density-specific launcher images.

successCriteria.scenario: The Android resource merger builds the app after the icon asset and XML references are added.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: assembleDebug succeeds and the installed package reports the new icon in the system app-info and listener-settings surfaces.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug --no-daemon passed after icon integration; installed APK showed the icon in Android system settings.

goals.evidence: User explicitly invoked $app-icon-generator; existing launcher foreground is a bitmap source at drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml and the source PNG is already modified in the dirty worktree.
